title: Overpass Delay

items.label: Narrow Detour
items.description: A pedestrian and rickshaw squeeze through a narrow temporary passage beside an overpass work site.
items.visual_focus: a pedestrian and rickshaw squeezing between temporary work barriers
items.local_cue: a maroon battery-run easy bike and pedestrian squeezed beside Rajshahi flyover work barriers

items.label: Muddy Approach
items.description: Rain turns the road beside an unfinished structure into deep mud.
items.visual_focus: a vehicle wheel sinking into mud beside an unfinished concrete pier
items.local_cue: a battery-run easy bike wheel in mud beside an unfinished concrete flyover pier

items.label: Crossing Work Zone
items.description: A rider steers around a barrier to reach the other side of the road.
items.visual_focus: a rider steering tightly around a work-zone barrier
items.local_cue: an easy-bike driver steering beside a striped flyover construction barrier

items.label: Wrong Turn
items.description: A driver turns into a blocked lane and must reverse in traffic.
items.visual_focus: a driver forced to reverse from a fully blocked lane
items.local_cue: a battery-run easy bike reversing from a blocked Rajshahi city lane

items.label: Closed Road
items.description: Closed road space remains beside an unfinished overpass pier.
items.visual_focus: a closed lane and large barrier directly beside unfinished overpass pillars
items.local_cue: unfinished flyover pillars and a concrete road barricade on a Rajshahi street

items.label: Confusing Junction
items.description: Several travellers stop at a confusing junction with no clear detour arrow.
items.visual_focus: travellers hesitating at a fork with several conflicting barricades
items.local_cue: a maroon easy bike hesitating at conflicting temporary barriers near an unfinished flyover

questions: Which two scenes make the detour hardest to follow?
How has roadwork changed a trip you make in Rajshahi?
Should the first fix protect walkers or guide drivers? Why?
Why can a delayed work site create costs for nearby shops?
If one detour becomes easier, where might traffic build up?
You have 300,000 BDT and 30 days. What one safe-detour pilot would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Test one temporary pedestrian route and clear detour guidance around a work site; do not fund construction itself.
